approvalScope: Frozen B v6 visual/page baseline only. This Cocos implementation and curve equivalence still need actual runtime visual review.

binding.target: video unlock, outfit purchase success, and frozen UI reward portrait/decorative nodes
binding.units: Multipliers of each node's immutable authored scale; key time in seconds.
binding.easePlacement: Destination key owns segment easing, matching Juice sampleTimeline.
binding.reset: Start each new reveal at t=0; restore authored scale on exit or reset.
binding.retrigger: Ignore duplicate unlock while its modal is open; no stacked tween or duplicate ownership grant.
binding.pause: Freeze elapsed time while paused or backgrounded; resume without catch-up.
binding.reducedMotion: System reduced-motion preference initializes the Motion setting. Turning the setting on or using the local M review key skips movement by evaluating the terminal scale 1; action buttons and granted ownership remain available.
binding.interruption: Dispose old reward nodes and timer when leaving or replacing modal; no deferred callbacks.
binding.ownership: Local review fixture grants occur before presentation; the generic reward fixture grants Mint ownership. No payment, gameplay consequence or grant on clip completion.

layoutIdentity.purpose: Bind the larger frozen-layout extraction through this small clip configuration; checked by inspect-motion.mjs.
